_note: v2.3 replan V5 (the imported-chat half, live, no model). A chat file imported from another install carries its metadata stamped with the ORIGINAL chat id. Opening it must read no story and leave the blob alone (the V5 guard); the author's explicit select must then ADOPT it: restamp the blob for this chat and keep its state, not restart it. The state is marked with a player flag before the stamp is changed, and adoption is proven on the server's copy of the chat, not in the page. T7 wave C (2026-10-03): the chat plays an inline story with NO checkpoint effects instead of sun-ruins. Since story-scoped lore (T5-2-2, f7342021) sun-ruins' Xentar Checkpoints requirement reads met, so its start checkpoint applies its Author's Note and cast changes and the effect ledger holds rows. Re-reading the chat as storyless clears the story, and clearStory first runs the exit restore (runtimeManager.ts:211, effects.restoreFor(extras, 'exit')), which settles those rows on the in-memory extras; this fixture swaps the stamp IN PLACE on the same chat, so those extras are the very blob under test (persist keeps them by reference) and the byte check failed on the restore, not on the foreign read. A real foreign blob arrives with a chat change, when the restore settles the previous chat's extras. A guard step requires an empty effect ledger before the stamp swap, so the byte check is about the read alone.

import_story.title: SO-V5B Adopt
import_story.description: v2.3 replan V5: a story with no checkpoint effects, so loading, leaving and re-reading it writes nothing outside the story blob.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.flagMoment('V5B adopt marker'); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const blob = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; const storyId = rt.getSnapshot().storyId; const marked = JSON.stringify(blob?.stories?.[storyId]?.extras?.journal ?? []).includes('V5B adopt marker'); if (!marked) throw new Error('setup: the marker flag is not in the persisted blob'); globalThis.__v5b = { storyId, own: String(ctx.chatId) }; return globalThis.__v5b;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const blob = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; if ((rt.getSnapshot().effects?.ledger ?? []).length) throw new Error(`setup: the effect ledger must be empty before the stamp swap, or the exit restore settles rows on this very blob: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().effects.ledger.map((row) => row.effect))}`); blob.chatId = 'so-v5b-imported-from-elsewhere'; const before = JSON.stringify(blob); await rt.loadSelectedFromChat(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); const read = rt.getSnapshot().storyId; const untouched = JSON.stringify(ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator) === before; if (read !== null) throw new Error(`the imported chat's foreign blob was read as this chat's story: ${read}`); if (!untouched) throw new Error('opening the imported chat changed its foreign blob'); return { read, untouched };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ok = await rt.selectStory(globalThis.__v5b.storyId); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && rt.getSnapshot().storyId !== globalThis.__v5b.storyId; i += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); await ctx.saveMetadata(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); const chatId = String(ctx.chatId); const response = await fetch('/api/chats/group/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id: chatId }), cache: 'no-cache' }); const lines = await response.json(); const stored = Array.isArray(lines) ? lines[0]?.chat_metadata?.story_orchestrator : null; const kept = JSON.stringify(stored?.stories?.[globalThis.__v5b.storyId]?.extras?.journal ?? []).includes('V5B adopt marker'); const result = { ok, story: rt.getSnapshot().storyId, pageStamp: ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator?.chatId ?? null, serverStamp: stored?.chatId ?? null, chatId, kept }; if (!ok || result.story !== globalThis.__v5b.storyId) throw new Error(`the explicit select did not load the story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.serverStamp !== chatId) throw new Error(`the server copy still carries the foreign stamp, so the chat was not adopted: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (!kept) throw new Error(`adoption lost the chat's state (the marker flag is gone): ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;
